definitions.explanation: A state where opposing forces or influences are equal, creating stability.

examples.japanese: ⟦{需要|じゅよう}→需要：02616_juyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{供給|きょうきゅう}→供給：02599_kyoukyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{均衡|きんこう}。
examples.english: The balance of supply and demand.

examples.japanese: {均衡|きんこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れた→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧。
⟦{勢力|せいりょく}→勢力：11812_seiryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{均衡|きんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧。
examples.english: To maintain a balance of power.

notes:
Composed of {均|きん} (equal) + {衡|こう} (balance/scales). A formal/academic term, more technical than the loanword ⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {均衡|きんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧: to maintain balance
- {均衡|きんこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れる→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧: balance breaks down
- {均衡|きんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to achieve balance
- {均衡|きんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: to lose balance

FIELDS OF USE:
- Economics: ⟦{需給|じゅきゅう}→需給：05920_jukyuu⟧{均衡|きんこう} (supply-demand equilibrium)
- Politics: ⟦{勢力|せいりょく}→勢力：11812_seiryoku⟧{均衡|きんこう} (balance of power)
- Science: ⟦{化学|かがく}→化学：05336_kagaku_chem⟧⟦{平衡|へいこう}→平衡：20597_heikou⟧ (chemical equilibrium — uses ⟦{平衡|へいこう}→平衡：20597_heikou⟧)
- Military: ⟦{軍事|ぐんじ}→軍事：14392_gunji⟧{均衡|きんこう} (military balance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {均衡|きんこう}: balance (formal, abstract, used in written/academic contexts)
- ⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧: balance (everyday, also used for physical balance)
- ⟦{平衡|へいこう}→平衡：20597_heikou⟧: equilibrium (scientific/technical, even more formal)
